verdict.rationale: The axis applies: a SaaS payments platform with public developer docs could publish llms.txt or agent-oriented docs. Direct probes found nothing: llms.txt returned HTTP 404, the markdown docs variant returned 404, and every candidate OpenAPI spec path returned 404. No documentation mentions agent-oriented or LLM-friendly docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
